name: plan-steps
description: Shows the plan's steps when there is one (task list, approved plan or plan file): the /steps pane and a quiet status line; keeps an open plan across /clear and compaction, and asks before an answer leaves steps open

holdFinish.title: Hold the finish
holdFinish.description: When an answer leaves plan steps open, ask Claude to go on by itself (at most twice per plan) before showing the card
